technology_name: Functional Noodles from Cassava and Sweet Potato
institution: ICAR-Central Tuber Crops Research Institute (CTCRI) Thiruvananthapuram
problem_solved: Functional Gluten-Free Noodles from Sweet Potato and Cassava (Tapioca)
description:
Functional noodles were prepared from sweet potato/ cassava starch by fortifying them with ingredients such as resistant starch and fibers. These noodles have a medium glycaemic index. Starch noodles developed from tuber starches such as cassava and Sweet potatoes are essentially gluten-free and hence an ideal choice for celiac patients.
A source of protein 20% retention in cooked sweet potato noodles.
applications:
Functional and health food manufacturing companies
Gluten-free and specialty food product manufacturers
Nutraceutical and wellness food enterprises
Cassava and sweet potato processing industries
Institutional catering, healthcare nutrition, and diabetic-friendly food providers
